test_case.test_name: Parameterized3DS RDIMM part, SPD, capacity and slot-topology validation
test_case.purpose: Verify every installed module is an approved3DS RDIMM and that rank/stack/type, capacity and slots1-24 population match the platform specification.
required_package: Approved DIMM manufacturer/part/serial list and vendor3DS documentation
Authorized SPD decoder or vendor evidence identifying rank/stack construction
Expected type/rank/capacity/speed/ECC and slots1-24 population map
BIOS screenshots plus secure dmidecode/meminfo/free/NUMA collection
Installed-versus-usable tolerance and ECC/SEL/thermal abort policy
test_case.test_command: Operator captures BIOS Memory Topology. Securely collect complete `dmidecode -t memory`, meminfo, free and NUMA inventory; map every populated locator to part/serial/type/rank/capacity/speed; use only the approved SPD/vendor authority to prove3DS construction; reconcile installed and usable capacity within the approved reservation tolerance.
test_case.expected_result: All populated slots contain approved3DS RDIMM parts with matching rank/stack/type/capacity/speed/ECC, topology and usable-memory accounting, with no ECC or platform fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative3DS part/SPD evidence for every module plus complete topology/capacity reconciliation. DMI capacity or the word RDIMM alone cannot prove3DS.
safety_gate: Read-only OS collection; physical DIMM handling remains operator-only.
Use only approved signed/read-only SPD tooling.
Do not infer3DS from capacity, rank count or generic DMI alone.
Abort on ECC/SEL/thermal instability; no automatic retry or reseat.
expected_evidence: Raw DMI, meminfo, free and NUMA evidence
Capacity tolerance, ECC/SEL and final verdict
test_case.recovery: If part/SPD identity is unreadable or a slot is mismatched, preserve the per-slot map and ECC/SEL state, make no automated SPD write or DIMM power operation, and hand the slot/serial discrepancy to the memory owner for controlled shutdown, inspection or reseat.
